page.layout: One page of blank paper with a small printed or stamped device (a monogram-like emblem) in the centre; no text blocks, no margin text.
page.notes: The page is blank vellum-coloured paper with a small dark device in the centre, apparently a stamp or printer's/owner's mark, containing no legible letters beyond what appears to be an intertwined monogram. No running text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature are printed. Marks at the right edge are binding tabs or stains and are not printed text.
